get.description: Get unified asset total balance chart columns.

parameters.description: Standard history window. Defaults to 1 day when unspecified.
parameters.name: range

schema.description: Standard history window. Defaults to 1 day when unspecified.
schema.title: range

parameters.description:
Optional explicit bucket. Allowed values are 1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 8h, 12h, or 1d.
 Valid buckets depend on range to keep chart payloads near 1k points.
 When omitted, the server picks the default bucket for the selected range.
